title: Augmenting signatures made elsewhere
description: Raises signatures made by another product (a signing portal, a desktop signer, another library) with SimpleSign's augmenters, without signing again: raise to B-LT, then B-LTA, then renew the archive time-stamp. Upload the files on the Playbook tab; the steps of a format whose file is missing are skipped. The time-stamps come from the Sandbox's TSA (change timestamp.provider to DigiCert, Sectigo or a URL of yours to keep the result); the revocation data come from the URLs in the file's certificates. Each step validates its result (default trust: the operating system's roots, the public TSAs and the Sandbox's) and shows the level the file had before.

inputs.title: A signed PDF (PAdES)
inputs.description: A PDF signed by any product, at any level up to B-LT. Its last signature is raised; earlier ones keep what they have.

inputs.title: A CMS signature with its content inside (CAdES, .p7m)
inputs.description: An enveloping CMS signature (the signed content travels inside it). For a detached .p7s use the next two inputs instead.

inputs.title: A detached CMS signature (CAdES, .p7s)
inputs.description: A detached CMS signature: its content is uploaded separately in the next input, and both are needed for every step of that section.

inputs.title: The content the detached CMS signature signs
inputs.description: The file the detached .p7s signs, exactly as it was signed: without it the time-stamps cannot be checked against the content.

inputs.title: A signed XML (XAdES, enveloped or enveloping)
inputs.description: An XML with an enveloped or enveloping XAdES signature. A detached XAdES that points at files by URL is not covered: its references cannot be resolved here.

sections.title: PAdES
sections.description: The uploaded PDF (input:pades), raised in incremental updates: the bytes already signed are never touched, so the other product's signatures stay valid.

steps.title: PAdES: raise to B-LT
steps.description: Adds a signature time-stamp if the file has none, then the chain's certificates and revocation data, fetched from the URLs in the certificates (AIA, CRL, OCSP): the file becomes verifiable without asking the issuer again.

steps.title: PAdES: raise the B-LT to B-LTA
steps.description: Adds an archive time-stamp over the B-LT made by the step before (and the validation data of its own time-stamp): the long-term preservation level, renewable before the time-stamp's certificate expires.

steps.title: PAdES: renew the archive time-stamp
steps.description: Renews the B-LTA of the step before: the validation data of its last archive time-stamp, then a new archive time-stamp over everything. Done again before each time-stamp's certificate expires, it keeps the signature verifiable indefinitely.

sections.title: CAdES with the content inside
sections.description: The uploaded .p7m (input:cades): the time-stamp and validation data go into the unsigned attributes of its SignerInfo.

steps.title: CAdES: raise to B-LT

sections.description: The uploaded .p7s with its content (input:cades-detached and input:cades-data): the content is read to check the time-stamps, and stays outside the signature.
